scope: Expose independent-task reuse from the main conversation, prefill its initial goal, explain current versus frozen agent versions, keep source lineage, protect existing drafts and unresolved submissions, and fence asynchronous new-task/configuration-return preparation by scope and request ownership.
prior_behavior: The legacy run detail exposed copy-run, but the main conversation did not. The compact form omitted old/current agent comparison. New-task and configuration-return reads could apply after a route or workspace change; copying a source also allowed autosave to replace an existing unrelated draft without a separate choice.

coverage: Independent task ID with current agent and empty conversation history
No inherited grant or failure scenario
Archived source with a different available agent
backend.implementation: Reuses the existing accepted-task/source_run_id contract; backend application changes only register the new static script. The related suite has 40 tests; an earlier 50-test invocation inadvertently rediscovered an imported test class before the import was changed to a module alias.

coverage: Old/current agent version explanation and escaping
Unrelated draft preservation and explicit replacement/adoption
Open editor and pending configuration preserved
Old completion cannot clear a newer preparation
frontend.fixture_change: The journey fixture is importable without rerunning its scenarios. A legacy test now closes the existing form before opening a genuinely new editor; calling newTask while its editor is already open now preserves and focuses that editor.

checks: 任务对话入口带入初始目标和当前智能体版本，清楚说明范围与配置变化；已有设置草稿保持独立，准备过程不提交任务
明确开始后获得独立新任务、空对话历史和当前配置，保留来源链接；原任务、对话草稿及已有设置草稿均不变
原智能体归档后必须重新选择；可明确恢复旧草稿或保存复用设置，刷新恢复保留来源且不冒充历史配置版本
迟到配置不能覆盖新任务窗口；准备失败不打开空表单，解除故障后可重试；八种布局的焦点与边界通过检查
两页面保存冲突保留本页输入，核对后仍防止覆盖再次更新的草稿，显式选择才能替换设置
过期确认不能放弃新草稿，重新检查只读取内容，再次明确确认才会清理
提交过期草稿仍创建本页任务，同时保留其他页面的新草稿与界面回执
放弃已提交但回执丢失时保留输入，再次请求也不能清理后来创建的新草稿
回执丢失后继续编辑不另建任务，核对并打开同一已受理记录
未受理时显式采用当前配置并保留目标，核对后再变化仍拒绝旧版本，重试编号不变
刷新后恢复待核对编号，读取不会提交，明确另建后才使用新编号创建任务
暂未找到之后原请求晚到受理，继续提交仍共用原编号，冲突后可查回原任务且不重复创建
通过真实下载保存并离线校验完整任务包，含所有轮次和两次修改；排队、取消、未保存内容边界正确，两个草稿保留
下载失败后显示具体原因并保留明确重试入口，重试只下载一次且键盘焦点可继续操作
切换任务中止旧下载，迟到响应不会替新任务触发文件下载或成功提示
执行后重新下载包含真实采用的修改内容和完整执行记录；八种主题、宽度及正常/28px 字号检查通过，下载没有写请求

iterations.note: Reuse and isolation assertions passed; the new verifier omitted archived:true from the existing agent archive API. The fixture request now includes the required explicit value.

All functional assertions passed. Visual review identified misleading wording treating an existing saved draft as a concurrent conflict. Final UI distinguishes the state, collapses saved details until requested and names the replacement action explicitly.

browser.visual_review: Inspected final light/dark reuse dialogs, old/current configuration comparison, saved-draft disclosure, explicit replacement/restoration options, goal/agent controls and fixed footer. Eight layouts verify 1024/1440 widths and actual 28px body/button text, keyboard focus, viewport bounds and no horizontal body overflow.
browser.isolation: Temporary Mock tasks. Completes a two-turn original, updates its agent, creates a new task through the real form, compares original run/events and independent history, follows the source link, archives the original agent, explicitly saves/restores settings, reloads, delays one configuration read and injects one 503 response. Existing conversation and settings drafts remain separate; no real model or business calls.

limits: Conversation reuse copies the initial goal, not later messages, replies, edit history or execution state. It is separate from retrying a failed turn in the existing conversation.
The compact form uses the current selected agent and existing new-task defaults. It does not clone the old frozen configuration or expose legacy advanced budgets.
Saved settings retain source_run_id but not a frozen original-agent revision. Restored drafts explicitly say the original version can be inspected in the source task.
New tasks expose a link back to the source. No new reverse-lineage catalog or import/fork of the entire conversation is added.
Unrelated saved settings pause autosave for the copied form; its edited text is kept in the current editor until explicit replacement or task submission. Existing unload/close guards still apply.
A pending accepted-task receipt or retained configuration journey is handled before a different source prefill; no new request ID or duplicate task is created automatically.
Invalidation fences late read results. Already-issued configuration reads may still finish server-side; this is not transport-level cancellation.
Desktop coverage is two widths and enlarged form text, not all devices or uniform browser zoom.
Focused/full counts overlap. Version remains 1.3.0; no publication or repeated fresh installation.
